# Dawaniyah Games Studio

> Dawaniyah Games (دَوَانِيَّة الألعاب) is a game development and game design studio based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a team in Cologne, Germany. It builds mobile, PC, console and VR games in Unity and Unreal Engine, and offers game UI/UX design, 2D/3D art and animation, LiveOps and performance optimization. It also publishes UI Framework for Unity, a free open-source Unity UI framework.

## Studio

- [Home (English)](https://www.dawaniyahgames.com/): services, portfolio, team, FAQ, contact
- [Home (Arabic)](https://www.dawaniyahgames.com/ar/): شركة تطوير وتصميم ألعاب في السعودية
- Services: full-cycle game development, mobile game production (iOS and Android), game art and animation, game UI/UX design, LiveOps and support, performance optimization
- Projects: Dendon Games (social board games), Khuzama Games (puzzle and strategy), UI Framework for Unity (open source)
- Founder and tech director: Mohamed Moghazi, game engineer with 15+ years on large productions
- Contact: info@dawaniyahgames.com, +966 55 119 4463 (Saudi Arabia), +49 1522 9018095 (Germany)

## Unity tools

- [UI Framework for Unity](https://www.dawaniyahgames.com/uiframework/): free MIT-licensed Unity UI framework. A screen, popup and navigation manager for UGUI built on Addressable scenes and a LIFO state stack, with ten animation presets and an editor window that generates scripts, scenes and runtime config. Unity 2022.3 to Unity 6.
- [UI Framework LLM summary](https://www.dawaniyahgames.com/uiframework/llms.txt): install steps, API and concepts
- [UI Framework source](https://github.com/dawaniyah-games/UiFramework)
